name: Sahaja
subtitle: Personal super-app for meditation and more

apps.name: Sahaja
apps.subtitle: Meditation tracker with diamonds, streaks and widgets
apps.localizedDescription: Sahaja — effortless. Track your daily meditation vow: diamonds, coins, streaks, grace, and a daily darshan of the gurus. Includes home screen widgets.
apps.versionDescription: Letting go of the calendar's handle part-way now settles the fold smoothly into the month or week, carrying on at your finger's pace, instead of snapping there.

versions.localizedDescription: Letting go of the calendar's handle part-way now settles the fold smoothly into the month or week, carrying on at your finger's pace, instead of snapping there.
The calendar's fold now follows your finger's position directly and takes the drag ahead of the handle's tap, so the drag can't jolt part-way through the motion.
The calendar's fold now starts moving with your finger from the first moment you drag the handle, without the small jump it made as the drag began.
The calendar's month-to-week fold now follows your finger smoothly, with no shake when you start dragging the handle.

Polish: the journey's chest now glows against the light rising behind it; the calendar folds smoothly from month to week as you pull the handle, the rows sliding up into the selected week; and the challenge path on the Workout tab runs the full width of the screen.

Workout opens on a 4-week challenge: keep every planned session each week, four weeks straight, and earn the prize you name (it starts with your next session; a missed week starts it again at week 1). Tap the challenge for the journey, a stone path under a dusk sky with a gem for each week and your prize in a chest at the top. Below it: Today, This week (log a walk, run or game with +), Progress and your last session. Earn a certificate for each challenge and for finishing Prep, and save it to Photos or share it. The calendar shows each session's shape, your other activities and the weeks you kept. During a workout, a Live Activity on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island shows the rest time left and what's next, or the exercise and set you're on. Exercise GIFs now fill the width of the screen.

Workout becomes a follow-along in a new black-and-volt look. Start workout shows the session; Let's go! asks which warm-up and walks you through one exercise at a time with the set or lap you're on, your variation and the course GIF. Done starts the rest full screen and asks reps and effort (1–10), starting at the target so one tap saves a set that went to plan. Holds record how long you held; test days ask for the variation's name, a description and your max reps. Swipe up for the whole session, close anytime and Resume, and Finish shows the total time. Import your own warm-up GIFs in Workout settings › Warm-up GIFs.

Workout gets a calendar and plans around your week: rest days straight from Calimove's chart, sessions planned on your gym days (Mon–Fri by default) with missed days moving the plan to the next gym day, and a month and week calendar with a day sheet to start, preview or move a session. Back after three weeks or more, choose to jump back in, ease back in with the test week, or start over. Exercise GIFs from the course on each card: import calimove-gifs.json once in Workout settings › Exercise GIFs. Each exercise shows last time's sets, lets you change the variation, and nudges toward a harder or easier one.

New Workout tab for Calimove's Body Transformation Basics prep phase, in place of Water: sessions in order on the days that suit you, with rest-day and block rules and the next session's earliest date; test-week variations carried into every workout; a box per set, and logging a set starts the rest that follows it; a rest timer that alerts with the screen locked; course, warm-up and exercise video links; and Workout's own settings. Water Intake and its widget are removed, so take the Water widget off your Home Screen. The first session asks for notification permission for the rest alert. This update migrates the data store; don't reinstall 0.9.x afterwards.

A past day where you sat but fell short now keeps a half circle in the week row, the widget and History, instead of turning into a grey dot. Left half: morning only. Right half: evening only. Bottom half: both logged but below the floor.
Widget now follows the app's Theme setting in full. Session log sheet rebuilt on the same card rows as Settings. Vow editor's Save sits above the vow history.
Light theme, with a System / Light / Dark setting (the widget follows it). Settings rebuilt in the Go Club row style. Footer tagline on the Today screen.
Win screen: the diamond count now really rolls (1.4s odometer) and digit edges are no longer clipped.

Win screen polish: the diamond count rolls like an odometer (two digits, no clipping), nothing shifts as coins and lines appear, the sparkle burst fires once from the diamonds and a gold burst once from the coins, and the diamond is bigger.

Win screen after logging a session: the diamonds you earned roll up with a sparkle burst, coins land beside them, then the day's verdict and streak, the kriya-years line, and lifetime diamonds. Intensity follows the tier. Shown for new sessions only; edits just save.

Daily Spiritual Diary quote under the darshan photo: topic, quote, author and source book. Tap it to open the quote on the YSS website. Fetched once a day (spiritualdiary.org, with yssofindia.org as fallback); the last quote stays on screen when offline.
Fix: tapping a darshan photo opened the editor and then immediately pushed the photo list again on top of it. Back now works as expected.

Darshan photos: add your own guru portraits from Photos or Files (Settings → Darshan photos, or long-press the daily photo). Frame each one by dragging and pinching inside a live copy of the card. Hide any photo from the rotation, delete your own, reset framing. The altar composite is gone; the three built-in Yogananda portraits remain.

Vow editor: per-tier "Judge by day total" toggle. When on, the day's sessions are added together and must reach twice the per-session minimums (extras count), so one long sitting can hold the floor for the day; Today shows "Floor held for the day". Week row (app + widget): today's circle is half-filled once one main session is logged. History labels half-logged days.
Subtler background grain across the app, widget, and shrine card.
Settings menu (Vow, Reminders), day-grouped session history with an add button, and additive count chips in the log sheet.
Morning and evening practice reminders: set times in the vow editor; a reminder stays silent once that session is logged.
Grainy dark visual overhaul: daily darshan photo rotation, meditating-sage widget art, real diamond and coin icons, lotus app icon.
